entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to start a return for some shoes I purchased a couple of months ago.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF886-0907.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Lace Road Cycling Shoes. It looks like they were delivered about 64 days ago. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the problem? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the shoes?

It's a preference issue, I guess. I've tried to make them work, but after a few long rides, they've started giving me some serious blisters. I've adjusted the cleats several times, but the fit just isn't right for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear that they're causing blisters. Comfort is key, especially on a long ride. Let me just double-check our return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on your account right now.

That's great, thank you for making that so simple. I do appreciate it. Now, since I am a long-time customer and had this issue, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm planning to buy a different pair of cycling shoes from your site.

That's a reasonable request, Alex. Let me check your account. Yes, I see you're one of our VIP members. Given the trouble with the fit and as a thank you for your loyalty, I'd be happy to add a 20% discount coupon directly to your account. It will be valid for your next purchase.
Oh, 20% is even better than I'd hoped. That's perfect, thank you so much, Sarah. That really helps.

You're very welcome. The coupon is active now, and you should have that return label in your inbox. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, we'll issue the refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been extremely helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
